about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may attain by the understanding of a purified mind the things which we celebrate with solemn rite. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: by the understanding of a purified mind
who lives and reigns with You
